scientific_boundary: Primary evidence is DATA-003 fills linked to the DATA-003 current-universe order-book corpus. DATA-001 is not substituted as scientific evidence.
canonical_observable_clock: orderbook recorder receive time; venue source timestamp is diagnostic only
fill_linkage_priority: exact transaction_hash + token_id + economically consistent venue trade print
price/size/time signatures are diagnostics only and never sufficient for causal acceptance

V1.reason: V1 has book_snapshot/price_change evidence but no venue last_trade_price stream. DATA-003 block time is confirmation chronology, not proof of when the trade was observable relative to recorder book state.

V2.prebook_rule: book observed_at must be strictly earlier than linked venue trade observed_at; equal receive timestamps are AMBIGUOUS because no recoverable sequence exists
V2.source_timestamp_rule: retain venue timestamp for diagnosis; never use it to make a later recorder state appear pre-trade

AG6.prebook_rule: strictly earlier recorder receive time only; equal-time state is AMBIGUOUS
AG6.pooling_rule: do not pool with V2/V3 until source-stratified effects agree

V3.prebook_rule: last valid book state with (timestamp_received, sequence) strictly before the linked venue trade (timestamp_received, sequence)
V3.same_time_rule: same receive timestamp is allowed only when sequence proves the book event was earlier

staged_split.final_holdout_rule: Do not inspect B0 005H outcome effects until PRE_HOLDOUT_FREEZE.json is written for serious survivors.

cross_source_falsification: report V2, AG6 and V3 separately before pooling
require important mechanisms to survive market/event/time leave-outs
treat source-version dependence as evidence against transportability
